Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionGet ready for a journey full of challenges in Railroad Swap! Help Mat, an adorable train-driving cat, build the tracks needed to guide his train to the final destination. But be careful: the available pieces aren't enough to complete the entire route, so you'll need to think beyond the tracks! On a hexagonal grid, select, rotate, and reposition pieces to build the perfect route. Along the way, you'll find swap tiles that let you assign colors to tracks or empty spaces. When the train passes over them, their positions are swapped, transforming the board and revealing new possibilities for continuing the journey. Featuring 30 levels across 3 biomes inspired by the landscapes of Minas Gerais in Brazil, each challenge presents a short and strategic puzzle. Since the number of available tracks and colors is limited, you'll need to observe the board, anticipate the changes, and carefully consider each move before setting the train in motion. Use Hints when you need a little help, or Restart the level to try a new strategy. Rotate the pieces, organize the tracks, define the swaps, and discover how the board will change after the train passes through each point.
